verses.en: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
verses.fr: Révélation de Jésus-Christ, que Dieu lui a donnée pour montrer à ses serviteurs les choses qui doivent arriver bientôt, et qu''il a fait connaître, par l''envoi de son ange, à son serviteur Jean,
verses.am: ቶሎ ይሆን ዘንድ የሚገባውን ነገር ለባሪያዎቹ ያሳይ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ለኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የሰጠው በእርሱም የተገለጠው ይህ ነው፥ ኢየሱስም በመልአኩ ልኮ ለባሪያው ለዮሐንስ አመለከተ፥

verses.en: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
verses.fr: lequel a attesté la parole de Dieu et le témoignage de Jésus-Christ, tout ce qu''il a vu.
verses.am: እርሱም ለእግዚአብሔር ቃልና ለኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ምስክር ላየውም ሁሉ መሰከረ።

verses.en: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
verses.fr: Heureux celui qui lit et ceux qui entendent les paroles de la prophétie, et qui gardent les choses qui y sont écrites! Car le temps est proche.
verses.am: ዘመኑ ቀርቦአልና የሚያነበው፥ የትንቢቱን ቃል የሚሰሙትና በውስጡ የተጻፈውን የሚጠብቁት ብፁዓን ናቸው።

verses.en: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
verses.fr: Jean aux sept Eglises qui sont en Asie: que la grâce et la paix vous soient données de la part de celui qui est, qui était, et qui vient, et de la part des sept esprits qui sont devant son trône,

verses.en: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
verses.fr: et de la part de Jésus-Christ, le témoin fidèle, le premier-né des morts, et le prince des rois de la terre! A celui qui nous aime, qui nous a délivrés de nos péchés par son sang,
verses.am: ዮሐንስ በእስያ ላሉት ለሰባቱ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት፤ ካለውና ከነበረው ከሚመጣውም፥ በዙፋኑም ፊት ካሉት ከሰባቱ መናፍስት፥ ከታመነውም ምስክር ከሙታንም በኵር የምድርም ነገሥታት ገዥ ከሆነ ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን። ለወደደን ከኃጢአታችንም በደሙ ላጠበን፥

verses.en: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.fr: et qui a fait de nous un royaume, des sacrificateurs pour Dieu son Père, à lui soient la gloire et la puissance, aux siècles des siècles! Amen!
verses.am: መንግሥትም ለአምላኩና ለአባቱም ካህናት እንድንሆን ላደረገ፥ ለእርሱ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ክብርና ኃይል ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
verses.fr: Voici, il vient avec les nuées. Et tout oeil le verra, même ceux qui l''ont percé; et toutes les tribus de la terre se lamenteront à cause de lui. Oui. Amen!
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከደመና ጋር ይመጣል፤ ዓይንም ሁሉ የወጉትም ያዩታል፥ የምድርም ወገኖች ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ ዋይ ዋይ ይላሉ። አዎን፥ አሜን።

verses.en: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
verses.fr: Je suis l''alpha et l''oméga, dit le Seigneur Dieu, celui qui est, qui était, et qui vient, le Tout-Puissant.
verses.am: ያለውና የነበረው የሚመጣውም ሁሉንም የሚገዛ ጌታ አምላክ። አልፋና ዖሜጋ እኔ ነኝ ይላል።

verses.en: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: Moi Jean, votre frère, et qui ai part avec vous à la tribulation et au royaume et à la persévérance en Jésus, j''étais dans l''île appelée Patmos, à cause de la parole de Dieu et du témoignage de Jésus.
verses.am: እኔ ወንድማችሁ የሆንሁ ከእናንተም ጋር አብሬ መከራውንና መንግሥቱን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስንም ትዕግሥት የምካፈል ዮሐንስ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቃልና ስለ ኢየሱስ ምስክር ፍጥሞ በምትባል ደሴት ነበርሁ።

verses.en: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
verses.fr: Je fus ravi en esprit au jour du Seigneur, et j''entendis derrière moi une voix forte, comme le son d''une trompette,
verses.am: በጌታ ቀን በመንፈስ ነበርሁ፥ በኋላዬም የመለከትን ድምፅ የሚመስል ትላቅ ድምፅ ሰማሁ፥

verses.en: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
verses.fr: qui disait: Ce que tu vois, écris-le dans un livre, et envoie-le aux sept Eglises, à Ephèse, à Smyrne, à Pergame, à Thyatire, à Sardes, à Philadelphie, et à Laodicée.
verses.am: እንዲሁም። የምታየውን በመጽሐፍ ጽፈህ ወደ ኤፌሶንና ወደ ሰምርኔስ ወደ ጴርጋሞንም ወደ ትያጥሮንም ወደ ሰርዴስም ወደ ፊልድልፍያም ወደ ሎዶቅያም በእስያ ወዳሉት ወደ ሰባቱ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ላክ አለኝ።

verses.en: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
verses.fr: Je me retournai pour connaître quelle était la voix qui me parlait. Et, après m''être retourné, je vis sept chandeliers d''or,
verses.am: የሚናገረኝንም ድምፅ ለማየት ዘወር አልሁ፤ ዘወርም ብዬ ሰባት የወርቅ መቅረዞች አየሁ፥

verses.en: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
verses.fr: et, au milieu des sept chandeliers, quelqu''un qui ressemblait à un fils d''homme, vêtu d''une longue robe, et ayant une ceinture d''or sur la poitrine.
verses.am: በመቅረዞቹም መካከል የሰው ልጅ የሚመስለውን አየሁ፥ እርሱም እስከ እግሩ ድረስ ልብስ የለበሰው ደረቱንም በወርቅ መታጠቂያ የታጠቀ ነበር።

verses.en: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
verses.fr: Sa tête et ses cheveux étaient blancs comme de la laine blanche, comme de la neige; ses yeux étaient comme une flamme de feu;
verses.am: ራሱና የራሱ ጠጕርም እንደ ነጭ የበግ ጠጕር እንደ በረዶም ነጭ ነበሩ፥ ዓይኖቹም እንደ እሳት ነበልባል ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
verses.fr: ses pieds étaient semblables à de l''airain ardent, comme s''il eût été embrasé dans une fournaise; et sa voix était comme le bruit de grandes eaux.
verses.am: እግሮቹም በእቶን የነጠረ የጋለ ናስ ይመስሉ ነበር፥ ድምፁም እንደ ብዙ ውኃዎች ድምፅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
verses.fr: Il avait dans sa main droite sept étoiles. De sa bouche sortait une épée aiguë, à deux tranchants; et son visage était comme le soleil lorsqu''il brille dans sa force.
verses.am: በቀኝ እጁም ሰባት ከዋክብት ነበሩት፥ ከአፉም በሁለት ወገን የተሳለ ስለታም ሰይፍ ወጣ፤ ፊቱም በኃይል እንደሚበራ እንደ ፀሐይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
verses.fr: Quand je le vis, je tombai à ses pieds comme mort. Il posa sur moi sa main droite en disant: Ne crains point! Je suis le premier et le dernier,
verses.am: ባየሁትም ጊዜ እንደ ሞተ ሰው ሆኜ ከእግሩ በታች ወደቅሁ። ቀኝ እጁንም ጫነብኝ እንዲህም አለኝ። አትፍራ፤ ፊተኛውና መጨረሻው ሕያውም እኔ ነኝ፥

verses.en: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
verses.fr: et le vivant. J''étais mort; et voici, je suis vivant aux siècles des siècles. Je tiens les clefs de la mort et du séjour des morts.
verses.am: ሞቼም ነበርሁ እነሆም፥ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ሕያው ነኝ፥ የሞትና የሲኦልም መክፈቻ አለኝ።

verses.en: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
verses.fr: Ecris donc les choses que tu as vues, et celles qui sont, et celles qui doivent arriver après elles,
verses.am: እንግዲህ ያየኸውን አሁንም ያለውን ከዚህም በኋላ ይሆን ዘንድ ያለውን ጻፍ።

verses.en: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
verses.fr: le mystère des sept étoiles que tu as vues dans ma main droite, et des sept chandeliers d''or. Les sept étoiles sont les anges des sept Eglises, et les sept chandeliers sont les sept Eglises.
verses.am: በቀኝ እጄ ያየሃቸው የሰባቱ ከዋክብትና የሰባቱ የወርቅ መቅረዞች ምሥጢር ይህ ነው፤ ሰባቱ ከዋክብት የሰባቱ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት መላእክት ናቸው፥ ሰባቱም መቅረዞች ሰባቱ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ናቸው።

verses.en: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
verses.fr: Ecris à l''ange de l''Eglise d''Ephèse: Voici ce que dit celui qui tient les sept étoiles dans sa main droite, celui qui marche au milieu des sept chandeliers d''or:
verses.am: በኤፌሶን ወዳለው ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መልአክ እንዲህ ብለህ ጻፍ። በቀኝ እጁ ሰባቱን ከዋክብት የያዘው በሰባቱም የወርቅ መቅረዞች መካከል የሚሄደው እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:
verses.fr: Je connais tes oeuvres, ton travail, et ta persévérance. Je sais que tu ne peux supporter les méchants; que tu as éprouvé ceux qui se disent apôtres et qui ne le sont pas, et que tu les as trouvés menteurs;
verses.am: ሥራህንና ድካምህን ትዕግሥትህንም አውቃለሁ፤ ክፉዎችንም ልትታገሥ እንዳትችል፥ እንዲሁም ሳይሆኑ። ሐዋርያት ነን የሚሉቱን መርምረህ ሐሰተኞች ሆነው እንዳገኘሃቸው አውቃለሁ፤

verses.en: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
verses.fr: que tu as de la persévérance, que tu as souffert à cause de mon nom, et que tu ne t''es point lassé.
verses.am: ታግሠህማል፥ ስለ ስሜም ብለህ ጸንተህ አልደከምህም።

verses.en: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
verses.fr: Mais ce que j''ai contre toi, c''est que tu as abandonné ton premier amour.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን የምነቅፍብህ ነገር አለኝ የቀደመውን ፍቅርህን ትተሃልና።

verses.en: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi donc d''où tu es tombé, repens-toi, et pratique tes premières oeuvres; sinon, je viendrai à toi, et j''ôterai ton chandelier de sa place, à moins que tu ne te repentes.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከወዴት እንደ ወደቅህ አስብ ንስሐም ግባ የቀደመውንም ሥራህን አድርግ፤ አለዚያ እመጣብሃለሁ ንስሐም ባትገባ መቅረዝህን ከስፍራው እወስዳለሁ።

verses.en: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.
verses.fr: Tu as pourtant ceci, c''est que tu hais les oeuvres des Nicolaïtes, oeuvres que je hais aussi.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህ አለህ፤ እኔ ደግሞ የምጠላውን የኒቆላውያንን ሥራ ጠልተሃልና።

verses.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
verses.fr: Que celui qui a des oreilles entende ce que l''Esprit dit aux Eglises: A celui qui vaincra je donnerai à manger de l''arbre de vie, qui est dans le paradis de Dieu.
verses.am: መንፈስ ለአብያተ ክርስቲያናት የሚለውን ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ። ድል ለነሣው በእግዚአብሔር ገነት ካለው ከሕይወት ዛፍ እንዲበላ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.en: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
verses.fr: Ecris à l''ange de l''Eglise de Smyrne: Voici ce que dit le premier et le dernier, celui qui était mort, et qui est revenu à la vie:
verses.am: በሰምርኔስም ወዳለው ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መልአክ እንዲህ ብለህ ጻፍ። ሞቶ የነበረው ሕያውም የሆነው ፊተኛውና መጨረሻው እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
verses.fr: Je connais ta tribulation et ta pauvreté bien que tu sois riche, et les calomnies de la part de ceux qui se disent Juifs et ne le sont pas, mais qui sont une synagogue de Satan.
verses.am: መከራህንና ድህነትህን አውቃለሁ፥ ነገር ግን ባለ ጠጋ ነህ፤ የሰይጣንም ማኅበር ናቸው እንጂ አይሁድ ሳይሆኑ። አይሁድ ነን የሚሉት የሚሳደቡትን ስድብ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
verses.fr: Ne crains pas ce que tu vas souffrir. Voici, le diable jettera quelques-uns de vous en prison, afin que vous soyez éprouvés, et vous aurez une tribulation de dix jours. Sois fidèle jusqu''à la mort, et je te donnerai la couronne de vie.
verses.am: ልትቀበለው ያለህን መከራ አትፍራ። እነሆ፥ እንድትፈተኑ ዲያብሎስ ከእናንተ አንዳንዶቻችሁን በወኅኒ ሊያገባችሁ አለው፥ አሥር ቀንም መከራን ትቀበላላችሁ። እስከሞት ድረስ የታመንህ ሁን የሕይወትንም አክሊል እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
verses.fr: Que celui qui a des oreilles entende ce que l''Esprit dit aux Eglises: Celui qui vaincra n''aura pas à souffrir la seconde mort.
verses.am: መንፈስ ለአብያተ ክርስቲያናት የሚለውን ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ። ድል የነሣው በሁለተኛው ሞት አይጐዳም።

verses.en: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;
verses.fr: Ecris à l''ange de l''Eglise de Pergame: Voici ce que dit celui qui a l''épée aiguë, à deux tranchants:
verses.am: በጴርጋሞንም ወዳለው ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መልአክ እንዲህ ብለህ ጻፍ። በሁለት ወገን የተሳለ ስለታም ሰይፍ ያለው እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan's seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
verses.fr: Je sais où tu demeures, je sais que là est le trône de Satan. Tu retiens mon nom, et tu n''as pas renié ma foi, même aux jours d''Antipas, mon témoin fidèle, qui a été mis à mort chez vous, là où Satan a sa demeure.
verses.am: የሰይጣን ዙፋን ባለበት የምትኖርበትን አውቃለሁ፤ ስሜንም ትጠብቃለህ፥ ሰይጣንም በሚኖርበት፥ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተገደለው የታመነው ምስክሬ አንቲጳስ በነበረበት ዘመን እንኳ ሃይማኖቴን አልካድህም።

verses.en: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
verses.fr: Mais j''ai quelque chose contre toi, c''est que tu as là des gens attachés à la doctrine de Balaam, qui enseignait à Balak à mettre une pierre d''achoppement devant les fils d''Israël, pour qu''ils mangeassent des viandes sacrifiées aux idoles et qu''ils se livrassent à l''impudicité.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ለጣዖት የታረደውን እንዲበሉና እንዲሴስኑ በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ማሰናከያን ሊያኖርባቸው ባላቅን ያስተማረ የበልዓምን ትምህርት የሚጠብቁ በዚያ ከአንተ ጋር ስላሉ፥ የምነቅፍብህ ጥቂት ነገር አለኝ።

verses.en: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate.
verses.fr: De même, toi aussi, tu as des gens attachés pareillement à la doctrine des Nicolaïtes.
verses.am: እንዲሁ የኒቆላውያንን ትምህርት እንደ እነዚህ የሚጠብቁ ሰዎች ከአንተ ጋር ደግሞ አሉ።

verses.en: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.fr: Repens-toi donc; sinon, je viendrai à toi bientôt, et je les combattrai avec l''épée de ma bouche.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ንስሐ ግባ፤ አለዚያ ፈጥኜ እመጣብሃለሁ፥ በአፌም ሰይፍ እዋጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.
verses.fr: Que celui qui a des oreilles entende ce que l''Esprit dit aux Eglises: A celui qui vaincra je donnerai de la manne cachée, et je lui donnerai un caillou blanc; et sur ce caillou est écrit un nom nouveau, que personne ne connaît, si ce n''est celui qui le reçoit.
verses.am: መንፈስ ለአብያተ ክርስቲያናት የሚለውን ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ። ድል ለነሣው ከተሰወረ መና እሰጠዋለሁ፥ ነጭ ድንጋይንም እሰጠዋለሁ፥ በድንጋዩም ላይ ከተቀበለው በቀር አንድ ስንኳ የሚያውቀው የሌለ አዲስ ስም ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
verses.fr: Ecris à l''ange de l''Eglise de Thyatire: Voici ce que dit le Fils de Dieu, celui qui a les yeux comme une flamme de feu, et dont les pieds sont semblables à de l''airain ardent:
verses.am: በትያጥሮንም ወዳለው ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መልአክ እንዲህ ብለህ ጻፍ። እንደ እሳት ነበልባል የሆኑ ዓይኖች ያሉት በእቶንም የነጠረ የጋለ ናስ የሚመስሉ እግሮች ያሉት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.
verses.fr: Je connais tes oeuvres, ton amour, ta foi, ton fidèle service, ta constance, et tes dernières oeuvres plus nombreuses que les premières.
verses.am: ሥራህንና ፍቅርህን እምነትህንም አገልግሎትህንም ትዕግሥትህንም ከፊተኛውም ሥራህ ይልቅ የኋለኛው እንዲበዛ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.
verses.fr: Mais ce que j''ai contre toi, c''est que tu laisses la femme Jézabel, qui se dit prophétesse, enseigner et séduire mes serviteurs, pour qu''ils se livrent à l''impudicité et qu''ils mangent des viandes sacrifiées aux idoles.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን። ነቢይ ነኝ የምትለውን ባሪያዎቼንም እንዲሴስኑና ለጣዖት የታረደውን እንዲበሉ የምታስተምረውንና የምታስተውን ያችን ሴት ኤልዛቤልን ስለምትተዋት የምነቅፍብህ ነገር አለኝ፤

verses.en: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
verses.fr: Je lui ai donné du temps, afin qu''elle se repentît, et elle ne veut pas se repentir de son impudicité.
verses.am: ንስሐም እንድትገባ ጊዜ ሰጠኋት ከዝሙትዋም ንስሐ እንድትገባ አልወደደችም።

verses.en: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
verses.fr: Voici, je vais la jeter sur un lit, et envoyer une grande tribulation à ceux qui commettent adultère avec elle, à moins qu''ils ne se repentent de leurs oeuvres.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በአልጋ ላይ እጥላታለሁ፥ ከእርስዋም ጋር የሚያመነዝሩትን ከሥራዋ ንስሐ ባይገቡ በታላቅ መከራ እጥላቸዋለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.
verses.fr: Je ferai mourir de mort ses enfants; et toutes les Eglises connaîtront que je suis celui qui sonde les reins et les coeurs, et je vous rendrai à chacun selon vos oeuvres.
verses.am: ልጆችዋንም በሞት እገድላቸዋለሁ፤ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትም ሁሉ ኵላሊትንና ልብን የምመረምር እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ፥ ለእያንዳንዳችሁም እንደ ሥራችሁ እሰጣችኋለሁ።

verses.en: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.
verses.fr: A vous, à tous les autres de Thyatire, qui ne reçoivent pas cette doctrine, et qui n''ont pas connu les profondeurs de Satan, comme ils les appellent, je vous dis: Je ne mets pas sur vous d''autre fardeau;
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ይህን ትምህርት ለማትይዙ ሁሉ የሰይጣንንም ጥልቅ ነገር እነርሱ እንደሚሉት ለማታውቁ ለእናንተ በትያጥሮን ለቀራችሁት እላለሁ፤ ሌላ ሸክም አልጭንባችሁም፥

verses.en: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.
verses.fr: seulement, ce que vous avez, retenez-le jusqu''à ce que je vienne.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እስክመጣ ድረስ ያላችሁን ጠብቁ።

verses.en: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
verses.fr: A celui qui vaincra, et qui gardera jusqu''à la fin mes oeuvres, je donnerai autorité sur les nations.
verses.am: የንጋትንም ኮከብ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.en: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
verses.fr: Il les paîtra avec une verge de fer, comme on brise les vases d''argile, ainsi que moi-même j''en ai reçu le pouvoir de mon Père.
verses.am: የንጋትንም ኮከብ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will give him the morning star.
verses.fr: Et je lui donnerai l''étoile du matin.
verses.am: መንፈስ ለአብያተ ክርስቲያናት የሚለውን ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.fr: Que celui qui a des oreilles entende ce que l''Esprit dit aux Eglises!
verses.am: መንፈስ ለአብያተ ክርስቲያናት የሚለውን ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.en: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
verses.fr: Ecris à l''ange de l''Eglise de Sardes: Voici ce que dit celui qui a les sept esprits de Dieu et les sept étoiles: Je connais tes oeuvres. Je sais que tu passes pour être vivant, et tu es mort.
verses.am: በሰርዴስም ወዳለው ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መልአክ እንዲህ ብለህ ጻፍ። ሰባቱ የእግዚአብሔር መናፍስትና ሰባቱ ከዋክብት ያሉት እንዲህ ይላል። ሥራህን አውቃለሁ ሕያው እንደ መሆንህ ስም አለህ ሞተህማል።

verses.en: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
verses.fr: Sois vigilant, et affermis le reste qui est près de mourir; car je n''ai pas trouvé tes oeuvres parfaites devant mon Dieu.
verses.am: ሥራህን በአምላኬ ፊት ፍጹም ሆኖ አላገኘሁትምና የነቃህ ሁን፥ ሊሞቱም ያላቸውን የቀሩትን ነገሮች አጽና።

verses.en: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
verses.fr: Rappelle-toi donc comment tu as reçu et entendu, et garde, et repens-toi. Si tu ne veilles pas, je viendrai comme un voleur, et tu ne sauras pas à quelle heure je viendrai sur toi.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንዴት እንደ ተቀበልህና እንደ ሰማህ አስብ፥ ጠብቀውም ንስሐም ግባ። እንግዲያስ ባትነቃ እንደ ሌባ እመጣብሃለሁ በማናቸውም ሰዓት እንድመጣብህ ከቶ አታውቅም።

verses.en: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
verses.fr: Cependant tu as à Sardes quelques hommes qui n''ont pas souillé leurs vêtements; ils marcheront avec moi en vêtements blancs, parce qu''ils en sont dignes.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ልብሳቸውን ያላረከሱ በሰርዴስ ጥቂት ሰዎች ከአንተ ጋር አሉ፥ የተገባቸውም ስለ ሆኑ ነጭ ልብስ ለብሰው ከእኔ ጋር ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
verses.fr: Celui qui vaincra sera revêtu ainsi de vêtements blancs; je n''effacerai point son nom du livre de vie, et je confesserai son nom devant mon Père et devant ses anges.
verses.am: ድል የነሣው እንዲሁ በነጭ ልብስ ይጐናጸፋል፥ ስሙንም ከሕይወት መጽሐፍ አልደመስስም፥ በአባቴና በመላእክቱም ፊት ለስሙ እመሰክርለታለሁ።

verses.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.fr: Que celui qui a des oreilles entende ce que l''Esprit dit aux Eglises!
verses.am: መንፈስ ለአብያተ ክርስቲያናት የሚለውን ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.en: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;
verses.fr: Ecris à l''ange de l''Eglise de Philadelphie: Voici ce que dit le Saint, le Véritable, celui qui a la clef de David, celui qui ouvre, et personne ne fermera, celui qui ferme, et personne n''ouvrira:
verses.am: በፊልድልፍያም ወዳለው ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መልአክ እንዲህ ብለህ ጻፍ። የዳዊት መክፈቻ ያለው፤ የሚከፍት፥ የሚዘጋም የሌለ፤ የሚዘጋ፥ የሚከፍትም የሌለ፤ ቅዱስና እውነተኛ የሆነው እርሱ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
verses.fr: Je connais tes oeuvres. Voici, parce que tu as peu de puissance, et que tu as gardé ma parole, et que tu n''as pas renié mon nom, j''ai mis devant toi une porte ouverte, que personne ne peut fermer.
verses.am: ሥራህን አውቃለሁ፤ እነሆ፥ በአንተ ፊት የተከፈተ በር ሰጥቼአለሁ ማንምም ሊዘጋው አይችልም፤ ኃይልህ ምንም ትንሽ ቢሆን ቃሌን ጠብቀሃልና፥ ስሜንም አልካድህምና።

verses.en: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
verses.fr: Voici, je te donne de ceux de la synagogue de Satan, qui se disent Juifs et ne le sont pas, mais qui mentent; voici, je les ferai venir, se prosterner à tes pieds, et connaître que je t''ai aimé.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አይሁድ ሳይሆኑ። አይሁድ ነን ከሚሉ ነገር ግን ከሚዋሹ ከሰይጣን ማኅበር አንዳንዶችን እሰጥሃለሁ እነሆ፥ መጥተው በእግሮችህ ፊት ይሰግዱ ዘንድ እኔም እንደ ወደድሁህ ያውቁ ዘንድ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
verses.fr: Parce que tu as gardé la parole de la persévérance en moi, je te garderai aussi à l''heure de la tentation qui va venir sur le monde entier, pour éprouver les habitants de la terre.
verses.am: የትዕግሥቴን ቃል ስለ ጠበቅህ እኔ ደግሞ በምድር የሚኖሩትን ይፈትናቸው ዘንድ በዓለም ሁሉ ላይ ሊመጣ ካለው ከፈተናው ሰዓት እጠብቅሃለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
verses.fr: Je viens bientôt. Retiens ce que tu as, afin que personne ne prenne ta couronne.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ቶሎ ብዬ እመጣለሁ፤ ማንም አክሊልህን እንዳይወስድብህ ያለህን አጽንተህ ያዝ።

verses.en: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
verses.fr: Celui qui vaincra, je ferai de lui une colonne dans le temple de mon Dieu, et il n''en sortira plus; j''écrirai sur lui le nom de mon Dieu, et le nom de la ville de mon Dieu, de la nouvelle Jérusalem qui descend du ciel d''auprès de mon Dieu, et mon nom nouveau.
verses.am: ድል የነሣው በአምላኬ መቅደስ ዓምድ እንዲሆን አደርገዋለሁ፥ ወደ ፊትም ከዚያ ከቶ አይወጣም፤ የአምላኬን ስምና የአምላኬን ከተማ ስም፥ ማለት ከሰማይ ከአምላኬ ዘንድ የምትወርደውን አዲሲቱን ኢየሩሳሌምን፥ አዲሱንም ስሜን በእርሱ ላይ እጽፋለሁ።

verses.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.fr: Que celui qui a des oreilles entende ce que l''Esprit dit aux Eglises!
verses.am: መንፈስ ለአብያተ ክርስቲያናት የሚለውን ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.en: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
verses.fr: Ecris à l''ange de l''Eglise de Laodicée: Voici ce que dit l''Amen, le témoin fidèle et véritable, le commencement de la création de Dieu:
verses.am: በሎዶቅያም ወዳለው ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መልአክ እንዲህ ብለህ ጻፍ። አሜን የሆነው፥ የታመነውና እውነተኛው ምስክር፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፍጥረት መጀመሪያ የነበረው እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
verses.fr: Je connais tes oeuvres. Je sais que tu n''es ni froid ni bouillant. Puisses-tu être froid ou bouillant!
verses.am: በራድ ወይም ትኩስ እንዳይደለህ ሥራህን አውቃለሁ። በራድ ወይም ትኩስ ብትሆንስ መልካም በሆነ ነበር።

verses.en: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
verses.fr: Ainsi, parce que tu es tiède, et que tu n''es ni froid ni bouillant, je te vomirai de ma bouche.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ለብ ስላልህ በራድም ወይም ትኩስ ስላልሆንህ ከአፌ ልተፋህ ነው።

verses.en: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
verses.fr: Parce que tu dis: Je suis riche, je me suis enrichi, et je n''ai besoin de rien, et parce que tu ne sais pas que tu es malheureux, misérable, pauvre, aveugle et nu,
verses.am: ሀብታም ነኝና ባለጠጋ ሆኜአለሁ አንድም ስንኳ አያስፈልገኝም የምትል ስለ ሆንህ፥ ጐስቋላና ምስኪንም ድሀም ዕውርም የተራቆትህም መሆንህን ስለማታውቅ፥

verses.en: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
verses.fr: je te conseille d''acheter de moi de l''or éprouvé par le feu, afin que tu deviennes riche, et des vêtements blancs, afin que tu sois vêtu et que la honte de ta nudité ne paraisse pas, et un collyre pour oindre tes yeux, afin que tu voies.
verses.am: ባለ ጠጋ እንድትሆን በእሳት የነጠረውን ወርቅ፥ ተጐናጽፈህም የራቁትነትህ ኃፍረት እንዳይገለጥ ነጭ ልብስን፥ እንድታይም ዓይኖችህን የምትኳለውን ኵል ከእኔ ትገዛ ዘንድ እመክርሃለሁ።

verses.en: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
verses.fr: Moi, je reprends et je châtie tous ceux que j''aime. Aie donc du zèle, et repens-toi.
verses.am: እኔ የምወዳቸውን ሁሉ እገሥጻቸዋለሁ እቀጣቸውማለሁ፤ እንግዲህ ቅና ንስሐም ግባ።

verses.en: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
verses.fr: Voici, je me tiens à la porte, et je frappe. Si quelqu''un entend ma voix et ouvre la porte, j''entrerai chez lui, je souperai avec lui, et lui avec moi.
verses.am: እነሆ በደጅ ቆሜ አንኳኳለሁ፤ ማንም ድምፄን ቢሰማ ደጁንም ቢከፍትልኝ፥ ወደ እርሱ እገባለሁ ከእርሱም ጋር እራት እበላለሁ እርሱም ከእኔ ጋር ይበላል።

verses.en: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
verses.fr: Celui qui vaincra, je le ferai asseoir avec moi sur mon trône, comme moi j''ai vaincu et me suis assis avec mon Père sur son trône.
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ ድል እንደ ነሣሁ ከአባቴም ጋር በዙፋኑ ላይ እንደተቀመጥሁ፥ ድል ለነሣው ከእኔ ጋር በዙፋኔ ላይ ይቀመጥ ዘንድ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.fr: Que celui qui a des oreilles entende ce que l''Esprit dit aux Eglises!
verses.am: መንፈስ ለአብያተ ክርስቲያናት የሚለውን ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.en: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.
verses.fr: Après cela, je regardai, et voici, une porte était ouverte dans le ciel. La première voix que j''avais entendue, comme le son d''une trompette, et qui me parlait, dit: Monte ici, et je te ferai voir ce qui doit arriver dans la suite.
verses.am: ከዚያ በኋላም አየሁ፥ እነሆም በሰማይ የተከፈተ ደጅ፥ እንደ መለከትም ሆኖ ሲናገረኝ የሰማሁት ፊተኛው ድምፅ። ወደዚህ ውጣና ከዚህ በኋላ ሊሆን የሚያስፈልገውን ነገር አሳይሃለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
verses.fr: Aussitôt je fus ravi en esprit. Et voici, il y avait un trône dans le ciel, et sur ce trône quelqu''un était assis.
verses.am: ወዲያው በመንፈስ ነበርሁ፤ እነሆም፥ ዙፋን በሰማይ ቆሞአል በዙፋኑም ላይ ተቀማጭ ነበረ፤

verses.en: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
verses.fr: Celui qui était assis avait l''aspect d''une pierre de jaspe et de sardoine; et le trône était environné d''un arc-en-ciel semblable à de l''émeraude.
verses.am: ተቀምጦም የነበረው በመልኩ የኢያስጲድንና የሰርዲኖን ዕንቍ ይመስል ነበር። በመልኩም መረግድን የመሰለ ቀስተ ደመና በዙፋኑ ዙሪያ ነበረ።

verses.en: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
verses.fr: Autour du trône je vis vingt-quatre trônes, et sur ces trônes vingt-quatre vieillards assis, revêtus de vêtements blancs, et sur leurs têtes des couronnes d''or.
verses.am: በዙፋኑ ዙሪያም ሀያ አራት ዙፋኖች ነበሩ፥ በዙፋኖቹም ላይ ነጭ ልብስ ለብሰው በራሳቸውም የወርቅ አክሊል ደፍተው ሀያ አራት ሽማግሌዎች ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.en: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
verses.fr: Du trône sortent des éclairs, des voix et des tonnerres. Devant le trône brûlent sept lampes ardentes, qui sont les sept esprits de Dieu.
verses.am: ከዙፋኑም መብረቅና ድምፅ ነጐድጓድም ይወጣል፤ በዙፋኑም ፊት ሰባት የእሳት መብራቶች ይበሩ ነበር፥ እነርሱም ሰባቱ የእግዚአብሔር መናፍስት ናቸው።

verses.en: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
verses.fr: Il y a encore devant le trône comme une mer de verre, semblable à du cristal. Au milieu du trône et autour du trône, il y a quatre êtres vivants remplis d''yeux devant et derrière.
verses.am: በዙፋኑም ፊት ብርሌ የሚመስል የብርጭቆ ባሕር ነበረ። በዙፋኑም መካከል በዙፋኑም ዙሪያ፥ በፊትና በኋላ ዓይኖች የሞሉአቸው አራት እንስሶች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
verses.fr: Le premier être vivant est semblable à un lion, le second être vivant est semblable à un veau, le troisième être vivant a la face d''un homme, et le quatrième être vivant est semblable à un aigle qui vole.
verses.am: ፊተኛውም እንስሳ አንበሳን ይመስላል፥ ሁለተኛውም እንስሳ ጥጃን ይመስላል፥ ሦስተኛውም እንስሳ እንደ ሰው ፊት ነበረው፥ አራተኛውም እንስሳ የሚበረውን ንስር ይመስላል።

verses.en: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
verses.fr: Les quatre êtres vivants ont chacun six ailes, et ils sont remplis d''yeux tout autour et au dedans. Ils ne cessent de dire jour et nuit: Saint, saint, saint est le Seigneur Dieu, le Tout-Puissant, qui était, qui est, et qui vient!
verses.am: አራቱም እንስሶች እያንዳንዳቸው ስድስት ክንፎች አሉአቸው፥ በዙሪያቸውና በውስጣቸውም ዓይኖች ሞልተውባቸዋል፤ ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ፥ የነበረውና ያለ የሚመጣውም ሁሉንም የሚገዛ ጌታ አምላክ እያሉ ቀንና ሌሊት አያርፉም።

verses.en: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,
verses.fr: Quand les êtres vivants rendent gloire et honneur et actions de grâces à celui qui est assis sur le trône, à celui qui vit aux siècles des siècles,
verses.am: እንስሶቹም በዙፋን ላይ ለተቀመጠው ከዘላለምም እስከ ዘላለም በሕይወት ለሚኖረው ለእርሱ ክብርና ውዳሴ ምስጋናም በሰጡት ጊዜ፥

verses.en: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
verses.fr: les vingt-quatre vieillards se prosternent devant celui qui est assis sur le trône, et ils adorent celui qui vit aux siècles des siècles, et ils jettent leurs couronnes devant le trône, en disant:

verses.en: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
verses.fr: Tu es digne, notre Seigneur et notre Dieu, de recevoir la gloire et l''honneur et la puissance; car tu as créé toutes choses, et c''est par ta volonté qu''elles existent et qu''elles ont été créées.
verses.am: ሀያ አራቱ ሽማግሌዎች በዙፋን ላይ በተቀመጠው ፊት ወድቀው፥ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም በሕይወት ለሚኖረው እየሰገዱ። ጌታችንና አምላካችን ሆይ፥ አንተ ሁሉን ፈጥረሃልና ስለ ፈቃድህም ሆነዋልና ተፈጥረውማልና ክብር ውዳሴ ኃይልም ልትቀበል ይገባሃል እያሉ በዙፋኑ ፊት አክሊላቸውን ያኖራሉ።

verses.en: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
verses.fr: Puis je vis dans la main droite de celui qui était assis sur le trône un livre écrit en dedans et en dehors, scellé de sept sceaux.
verses.am: በዙፋኑ ላይም በተቀመጠው በቀኝ እጁ ላይ በውስጥና በኋላ የተጻፈበት በሰባትም ማኅተም የተዘጋ መጽሐፍን አየሁ።

verses.en: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
verses.fr: Et je vis un ange puissant, qui criait d''une voix forte: Qui est digne d''ouvrir le livre, et d''en rompre les sceaux?
verses.am: ብርቱም መልአክ። መጽሐፉን ይዘረጋ ዘንድ ማኅተሞቹንም ይፈታ ዘንድ የሚገባው ማን ነው? ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ ሲያውጅ አየሁ።

verses.en: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.fr: Et personne dans le ciel, ni sur la terre, ni sous la terre, ne put ouvrir le livre ni le regarder.
verses.am: በሰማይም ቢሆን በምድርም ላይ ቢሆን ከምድርም በታች ቢሆን መጽሐፉን ሊዘረጋ ወይም ሊመለከተው ማንም አልተቻለውም።

verses.en: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.fr: Et je pleurai beaucoup de ce que personne ne fut trouvé digne d''ouvrir le livre ni de le regarder.
verses.am: መጽሐፉን ሊዘረጋ ወይም ሊመለከተው የሚገባው ማንም ስላልተገኘ እጅግ አለቀስሁ።

verses.en: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
verses.fr: Et l''un des vieillards me dit: Ne pleure point; voici, le lion de la tribu de Juda, le rejeton de David, a vaincu pour ouvrir le livre et ses sept sceaux.
verses.am: ከሽማግሌዎቹም አንዱ። አታልቅስ፤ እነሆ፥ ከይሁዳ ነገድ የሆነው አንበሳ እርሱም የዳዊት ሥር መጽሐፉን ይዘረጋ ዘንድ ሰባቱንም ማኅተም ይፈታ ዘንድ ድል ነሥቶአል አለኝ።

verses.en: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
verses.fr: Et je vis, au milieu du trône et des quatre êtres vivants et au milieu des vieillards, un agneau qui était là comme immolé. Il avait sept cornes et sept yeux, qui sont les sept esprits de Dieu envoyés par toute la terre.
verses.am: በዙፋኑና በአራቱ እንስሶች መካከልም በሽማግሌዎችም መካከል እንደ ታረደ በግ ቆሞ አየሁ፥ ሰባትም ቀንዶችና ሰባት ዓይኖች ነበሩት እነርሱም ወደ ምድር ሁሉ የተላኩ የእግዚአብሔር መናፍስት ናቸው።

verses.en: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
verses.fr: Il vint, et il prit le livre de la main droite de celui qui était assis sur le trône.
verses.am: መጥቶም በዙፋን ላይ ከተቀመጠ ከዚያ ከቀኝ እጁ መጽሐፉን ወሰደው።

verses.en: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
verses.fr: Quand il eut pris le livre, les quatre êtres vivants et les vingt-quatre vieillards se prosternèrent devant l''agneau, tenant chacun une harpe et des coupes d''or remplies de parfums, qui sont les prières des saints.
verses.am: መጽሐፉንም በወሰደ ጊዜ አራቱ እንስሶችና ሀያ አራቱ ሽማግሌዎች በበጉ ፊት ወደቁ፥ እያንዳንዳቸውም በገናንና የቅዱሳን ጸሎት የሆነ ዕጣን የሞላበትን የወርቅ ዕቃ ያዙ።

verses.en: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
verses.fr: Et ils chantaient un cantique nouveau, en disant: Tu es digne de prendre le livre, et d''en ouvrir les sceaux; car tu as été immolé, et tu as racheté pour Dieu par ton sang des hommes de toute tribu, de toute langue, de tout peuple, et de toute nation;
verses.am: አየሁም፥ በዙፋኑም በእንስሶቹም በሽማግሌዎቹም ዙሪያ የብዙ መላእክትን ድምፅ ሰማሁ፤ ቍጥራቸውም አእላፋት ጊዜ አእላፋትና ሺህ ጊዜ ሺህ ነበር፥

verses.en: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
verses.fr: tu as fait d''eux un royaume et des sacrificateurs pour notre Dieu, et ils régneront sur la terre.
verses.am: አየሁም፥ በዙፋኑም በእንስሶቹም በሽማግሌዎቹም ዙሪያ የብዙ መላእክትን ድምፅ ሰማሁ፤ ቍጥራቸውም አእላፋት ጊዜ አእላፋትና ሺህ ጊዜ ሺህ ነበር፥

verses.en: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
verses.fr: Je regardai, et j''entendis la voix de beaucoup d''anges autour du trône et des êtres vivants et des vieillards, et leur nombre était des myriades de myriades et des milliers de milliers.
verses.am: በታላቅም ድምፅ። የታረደው በግ ኃይልና ባለ ጠግነት ጥበብም ብርታትም ክብርም ምስጋናም በረከትም ሊቀበል ይገባዋል አሉ።

verses.en: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
verses.fr: Ils disaient d''une voix forte: L''agneau qui a été immolé est digne de recevoir la puissance, la richesse, la sagesse, la force, l''honneur, la gloire, et la louange.
verses.am: በሰማይና በምድርም ከምድርም በታች በባሕርም ላይ ያለ ፍጥረት ሁሉ በእነርሱም ውስጥ ያለ ሁሉ። በረከትና ክብር ምስጋናም ኃይልም ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም በዙፋኑ ላይ ለተቀመጠው፥ ለበጉም ይሁን ሲሉ ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Et toutes les créatures qui sont dans le ciel, sur la terre, sous la terre, sur la mer, et tout ce qui s''y trouve, je les entendis qui disaient: A celui qui est assis sur le trône, et à l''agneau, soient la louange, l''honneur, la gloire, et la force, aux siècles des siècles!
verses.am: አራቱም እንስሶች። አሜን አሉ፥ ሽማግሌዎቹም ወድቀው ሰገዱ።

verses.en: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Et les quatre êtres vivants disaient: Amen! Et les vieillards se prosternèrent et adorèrent.
verses.am: አራቱም እንስሶች። አሜን አሉ፥ ሽማግሌዎቹም ወድቀው ሰገዱ።

verses.en: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
verses.fr: Je regardai, quand l''agneau ouvrit un des sept sceaux, et j''entendis l''un des quatre êtres vivants qui disait comme d''une voix de tonnerre: Viens.
verses.am: በጉም ከሰባቱ ማኅተም አንዱን በፈታ ጊዜ አየሁ፥ ከአራቱም እንስሶች አንዱ ነጐድጓድ በሚመስል ድምፅ። መጥተህ እይ ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
verses.fr: Je regardai, et voici, parut un cheval blanc. Celui qui le montait avait un arc; une couronne lui fut donnée, et il partit en vainqueur et pour vaincre.
verses.am: አየሁም፥ እነሆም፥ አምባላይ ፈረስ ወጣ፥ በእርሱም ላይ የተቀመጠው ቀስት ነበረው፥ አክሊልም ተሰጠው፥ ድልም እየነሣ ወጣ ድል ለመንሣት።

verses.en: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
verses.fr: Quand il ouvrit le second sceau, j''entendis le second être vivant qui disait: Viens.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ ሁለተኛው እንስሳ። መጥተህ እይ ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
verses.fr: Et il sortit un autre cheval, roux. Celui qui le montait reçut le pouvoir d''enlever la paix de la terre, afin que les hommes s''égorgeassent les uns les autres; et une grande épée lui fut donnée.
verses.am: ሌላም ዳማ ፈረስ ወጣ፥ በእርሱም ላይ ለተቀመጠው ሰላምን ከምድር ይወስድ ዘንድ ሰዎችም እርስ በርሳቸው እንዲተራረዱ ሥልጣን ተሰጠው፥ ታላቅም ሰይፍ ተሰጠው።

verses.en: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
verses.fr: Quand il ouvrit le troisième sceau, j''entendis le troisième être vivant qui disait: Viens. Je regardai, et voici, parut un cheval noir. Celui qui le montait tenait une balance dans sa main.
verses.am: ሦስተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ ሦስተኛው እንስሳ። መጥተህ እይ ሲል ሰማሁ። አየሁም፥ እነሆም፥ ጕራቻ ፈረስ ወጣ፥ በእርሱም ላይ የተቀመጠው በእጁ ሚዛን ያዘ።

verses.en: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
verses.fr: Et j''entendis au milieu des quatre êtres vivants une voix qui disait: Une mesure de blé pour un denier, et trois mesures d''orge pour un denier; mais ne fais point de mal à l''huile et au vin.
verses.am: በአራቱም እንስሶች መካከል ድምፅ። አንድ እርቦ ስንዴ በዲናር ሦስት እርቦ ገብስም በዲናር፥ ዘይትንና ወይንንም አትጕዳ ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
verses.fr: Quand il ouvrit le quatrième sceau, j''entendis la voix du quatrième être vivant qui disait: Viens.
verses.am: አራተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ የአራተኛው እንስሳ ድምፅ። መጥተህ እይ ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
verses.fr: Je regardai, et voici, parut un cheval d''une couleur pâle. Celui qui le montait se nommait la mort, et le séjour des morts l''accompagnait. Le pouvoir leur fut donné sur le quart de la terre, pour faire périr les hommes par l''épée, par la famine, par la mortalité, et par les bêtes sauvages de la terre.
verses.am: አየሁም፥ እነሆም፥ ሐመር ፈረስ ወጣ፥ በእርሱም ላይ የተቀመጠው ስሙ ሞት ነበረ። ሲኦልም ተከተለው፤ በሰይፍና በራብም በሞትም በምድርም አራዊት ይገድሉ ዘንድ ከምድር በአራተኛዋ እጅ ላይ ሥልጣን ተሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:
verses.fr: Quand il ouvrit le cinquième sceau, je vis sous l''autel les âmes de ceux qui avaient été immolés à cause de la parole de Dieu et à cause du témoignage qu''ils avaient rendu.
verses.am: አምስተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ፥ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቃልና ስለ ጠበቁት ምስክር የታረዱትን የሰዎች ነፍሳት ከመሠዊያ በታች አየሁ።

verses.en: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
verses.fr: Ils crièrent d''une voix forte, en disant: Jusques à quand, Maître saint et véritable, tardes-tu à juger, et à tirer vengeance de notre sang sur les habitants de la terre?
verses.am: በታላቅ ድምፅም እየጮኹ። ቅዱስና እውነተኛ ጌታ ሆይ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ አትፈርድም ደማችንንስ በምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ እስከ መቼ አትበቀልም? አሉ።

verses.en: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
verses.fr: Une robe blanche fut donnée à chacun d''eux; et il leur fut dit de se tenir en repos quelque temps encore, jusqu''à ce que fût complet le nombre de leurs compagnons de service et de leurs frères qui devaient être mis à mort comme eux.
verses.am: ለእያንዳንዳቸውም ነጭ ልብስ ተሰጣቸው፥ እንደ እነርሱም ደግሞ ይገደሉ ዘንድ ያላቸው የባሪያዎች ባልንጀራዎቻቸውና የወንድሞቻቸው ቍጥር እስኪፈጸም ድረስ፥ ገና ጥቂት ዘመን እንዲያርፉ ተባለላቸው።

verses.en: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
verses.fr: Je regardai, quand il ouvrit le sixième sceau; et il y eut un grand tremblement de terre, le soleil devint noir comme un sac de crin, la lune entière devint comme du sang,
verses.am: ስድስተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ አየሁ፥ ታላቅም የምድር መናወጥ ሆነ፥ ፀሐይም እንደ ማቅ ጠጕር ጥቁር ሆነ፥ ጨረቃም በሞላው እንደ ደም ሆነ፥

verses.en: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
verses.fr: et les étoiles du ciel tombèrent sur la terre, comme lorsqu''un figuier secoué par un vent violent jette ses figues vertes.
verses.am: በለስም በብርቱ ነፋስ ተናውጣ ቃርያዋን ፍሬ እንደምትጥል የሰማይ ከዋክብት ወደ ምድር ወደቁ፥

verses.en: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
verses.fr: Le ciel se retira comme un livre qu''on roule; et toutes les montagnes et les îles furent remuées de leurs places.
verses.am: ሰማይም እንደ መጽሐፍ ተጠቅልሎ አለፈ፥ ተራራዎችና ደሴቶችም ሁሉ ከስፍራቸው ተወሰዱ።

verses.en: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
verses.fr: Les rois de la terre, les grands, les chefs militaires, les riches, les puissants, tous les esclaves et les hommes libres, se cachèrent dans les cavernes et dans les rochers des montagnes.
verses.am: የምድርም ነገሥታትና መኳንንት ሻለቃዎችም ባለ ጠጋዎችም ኃይለኛዎችም ባሪያዎችም ጌቶችም ሁሉ በዋሾችና በተራራዎች ዓለቶች ተሰወሩ፥

verses.en: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
verses.fr: Et ils disaient aux montagnes et aux rochers: Tombez sur nous, et cachez-nous devant la face de celui qui est assis sur le trône, et devant la colère de l''agneau;
verses.am: ተራራዎችንና ዓለቶችንም። በላያችን ውደቁ በዙፋንም ከተቀመጠው ፊት ከበጉም ቍጣ ሰውሩን፤

verses.en: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
verses.fr: car le grand jour de sa colère est venu, et qui peut subsister?
verses.am: ታላቁ የቁጣው ቀን መጥቶአልና፥ ማንስ ሊቆም ይችላል? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
verses.fr: Après cela, je vis quatre anges debout aux quatre coins de la terre; ils retenaient les quatre vents de la terre, afin qu''il ne soufflât point de vent sur la terre, ni sur la mer, ni sur aucun arbre.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ በአራቱ በምድር ማዕዘን ቆመው አራት መላእክት አየሁ፥ እነርሱም ነፋስ በምድር ቢሆን ወይም በባሕር ወይም በማንም ዛፍ እንዳይነፍስ አራቱን የምድር ነፋሳት ያዙ።

verses.en: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
verses.fr: Et je vis un autre ange, qui montait du côté du soleil levant, et qui tenait le sceau du Dieu vivant; il cria d''une voix forte aux quatre anges à qui il avait été donné de faire du mal à la terre et à la mer,
verses.am: የሕያው አምላክ ማኅተም ያለውም ሌላ መልአክ ከፀሐይ መውጫ ሲወጣ አየሁ፥ ምድርንና ባሕርንም ሊጐዱ ለተሰጣቸው ለአራቱ መላእክት በታላቅ ድምፅ እየጮኸ።

verses.en: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.
verses.fr: et il dit: Ne faites point de mal à la terre, ni à la mer, ni aux arbres, jusqu''à ce que nous ayons marqué du sceau le front des serviteurs de notre Dieu.
verses.am: የአምላካችንን ባሪያዎች ግምባራቸውን እስክናትማቸው ድረስ ምድርን ቢሆን ወይም ባሕርን ወይም ዛፎችን አትጕዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Et j''entendis le nombre de ceux qui avaient été marqués du sceau, cent quarante-quatre mille, de toutes les tribus des fils d''Israël:
verses.am: የታተሙትንም ቍጥር ሰማሁ፤ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ነገድ ሁሉ የታተሙት መቶ አርባ አራት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.fr: de la tribu de Juda, douze mille marqués du sceau; de la tribu de Ruben, douze mille; de la tribu de Gad, douze mille;
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ ታተሙ፥ ከሮቤል ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከጋድ ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥

verses.en: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nephthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.fr: de la tribu d''Aser, douze mille; de la tribu de Nephthali, douze mille; de la tribu de Manassé, douze mille;
verses.am: ከአሴር ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከንፍታሌም ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥

verses.en: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.fr: de la tribu de Siméon, douze mille; de la tribu de Lévi, douze mille; de la tribu d''Issacar, douze mille;
verses.am: ከምናሴ ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከስምዖን ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከሌዊ ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከይሳኮር ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥

verses.en: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.fr: de la tribu de Zabulon, douze mille; de la tribu de Joseph, douze mille; de la tribu de Benjamin, douze mille marqués du sceau.
verses.am: ከዛብሎን ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከዮሴፍ ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከብንያም ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ ታተሙ።

verses.en: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
verses.fr: Après cela, je regardai, et voici, il y avait une grande foule, que personne ne pouvait compter, de toute nation, de toute tribu, de tout peuple, et de toute langue. Ils se tenaient devant le trône et devant l''agneau, revêtus de robes blanches, et des palmes dans leurs mains.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ አንድ እንኳ ሊቆጥራቸው የማይችል ከሕዝብና ከነገድ ከወገንም ከቋንቋም ሁሉ እጅግ ብዙ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ ነጭ ልብስም ለብሰው የዘንባባንም ዝንጣፊዎች በእጆቻቸው ይዘው በዙፋኑና በበጉ ፊት ቆሙ፤

verses.en: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.
verses.fr: Et ils criaient d''une voix forte, en disant: Le salut est à notre Dieu qui est assis sur le trône, et à l''agneau.
verses.am: በታላቅም ድምፅ እየጮሁ። በዙፋኑ ላይ ለተቀመጠው ለአምላካችንና ለበጉ ማዳን ነው አሉ።

verses.en: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
verses.fr: Et tous les anges se tenaient autour du trône et des vieillards et des quatre êtres vivants; et ils se prosternèrent sur leurs faces devant le trône, et ils adorèrent Dieu,
verses.am: መላእክቱም ሁሉ በዙፋኑና በሽማግሌዎቹ በአራቱም እንስሶቹ ዙሪያ ቆመው ነበር፤ በዙፋኑም ፊት በግምባራቸው ተደፉ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም እየሰገዱ።

verses.en: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.fr: en disant: Amen! La louange, la gloire, la sagesse, l''action de grâces, l''honneur, la puissance, et la force, soient à notre Dieu, aux siècles des siècles! Amen!
verses.am: አሜን፥ በረከትና ክብር ጥበብም ምስጋናም ውዳሴም ኃይልም ብርታትም ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ለአምላካችን ይሁን፤ አሜን አሉ።

verses.en: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
verses.fr: Et l''un des vieillards prit la parole et me dit: Ceux qui sont revêtus de robes blanches, qui sont-ils, et d''où sont-ils venus?
verses.am: ከሽማግሌዎቹም አንዱ ተመልሶ። እነዚህ ነጩን ልብስ የለበሱ እነማን ናቸው? ከወዴትስ መጡ? አለኝ።

verses.en: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
verses.fr: Je lui dis: Mon seigneur, tu le sais. Et il me dit: Ce sont ceux qui viennent de la grande tribulation; ils ont lavé leurs robes, et ils les ont blanchies dans le sang de l''agneau.
verses.am: እኔም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ታውቃለህ አልሁት። አለኝም። እነዚህ ከታላቁ መከራ የመጡ ናቸው፥ ልብሳቸውንም አጥበው በበጉ ደም አነጹ።

verses.en: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.
verses.fr: C''est pour cela qu''ils sont devant le trône de Dieu, et le servent jour et nuit dans son temple. Celui qui est assis sur le trône dressera sa tente sur eux;
verses.am: ስለዚህ በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ፊት አሉ፥ ሌሊትና ቀንም በመቅደሱ ያመልኩታል፥ በዙፋኑም ላይ የተቀመጠው በእነርሱ ላይ ያድርባቸዋል።

verses.en: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
verses.fr: ils n''auront plus faim, ils n''auront plus soif, et le soleil ne les frappera point, ni aucune chaleur.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይራቡም፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ አይጠሙም፥ ፀሐይም ትኵሳትም ሁሉ ከቶ አይወርድባቸውም፤

verses.en: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
verses.fr: Car l''agneau qui est au milieu du trône les paîtra et les conduira aux sources des eaux de la vie, et Dieu essuiera toute larme de leurs yeux.
verses.am: በዙፋኑ መካከል ያለው በጉ እረኛቸው ይሆናልና፥ ወደ ሕይወትም ውኃ ምንጭ ይመራቸዋልና፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንባዎችን ሁሉ ከዓይናቸው ያብሳል።

verses.en: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
verses.fr: Quand il ouvrit le septième sceau, il y eut dans le ciel un silence d''environ une demi-heure.
verses.am: ሰባተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ እኵል ሰዓት የሚያህል ዝምታ በሰማይ ሆነ።

verses.en: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.
verses.fr: Et je vis les sept anges qui se tiennent devant Dieu, et sept trompettes leur furent données.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት የሚቆሙትን ሰባቱን መላእክት አየሁ፥ ሰባትም መለከት ተሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
verses.fr: Et un autre ange vint, et il se tint sur l''autel, ayant un encensoir d''or; on lui donna beaucoup de parfums, afin qu''il les offrît, avec les prières de tous les saints, sur l''autel d''or qui est devant le trône.
verses.am: ሌላም መልአክ መጣና የወርቅ ጥና ይዞ በመሰዊያው አጠገብ ቆመ፤ በዙፋኑም ፊት ባለው በወርቅ መሰዊያ ላይ ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ ጸሎት እንዲጨምረው ብዙ ዕጣን ተሰጠው።

verses.en: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.
verses.fr: La fumée des parfums monta, avec les prières des saints, de la main de l''ange devant Dieu.
verses.am: የዕጣኑም ጢስ ከቅዱሳን ጸሎት ጋር ከመልአኩ እጅ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጣ።

verses.en: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
verses.fr: Et l''ange prit l''encensoir, le remplit du feu de l''autel, et le jeta sur la terre. Et il y eut des voix, des tonnerres, des éclairs, et un tremblement de terre.
verses.am: መልአኩም ጥናውን ይዞ የመሰዊያውን እሳት ሞላበት ወደ ምድርም ጣለው፤ ነጐድጓድና ድምፅም መብረቅም መናወጥም ሆነ።

verses.en: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
verses.fr: Et les sept anges qui avaient les sept trompettes se préparèrent à en sonner.
verses.am: ሰባቱንም መለከት የያዙ ሰባቱ መላእክት ሊነፉ ተዘጋጁ።

verses.en: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
verses.fr: Le premier sonna de la trompette. Et il y eut de la grêle et du feu mêlés de sang, qui furent jetés sur la terre; et le tiers de la terre fut brûlé, et le tiers des arbres fut brûlé, et toute herbe verte fut brûlée.
verses.am: ፊተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ ደምም የተቀላቀለበት በረዶና እሳት ሆነ፥ ወደ ምድርም ተጣለ፤ የምድርም ሲሶው ተቃጠለ የዛፎችም ሲሶው ተቃጠለ የለመለመም ሣር ሁሉ ተቃጠለ።

verses.en: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
verses.fr: Le second ange sonna de la trompette. Et quelque chose comme une grande montagne embrasée par le feu fut jeté dans la mer; et le tiers de la mer devint du sang,
verses.am: ሁለተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ በእሳት የሚቃጠል ታላቅ ተራራን የሚመስል ነገር በባሕር ተጣለ፤ የባሕርም ሲሶው ደም ሆነ

verses.en: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
verses.fr: et le tiers des créatures qui étaient dans la mer et qui avaient vie mourut, et le tiers des navires périt.
verses.am: በባሕርም ከሚኖሩ ሕይወት ካላቸው ፍጥረቶች ሲሶው ሞተ የመርከቦችም ሲሶው ጠፋ።

verses.en: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;
verses.fr: Le troisième ange sonna de la trompette. Et il tomba du ciel une grande étoile ardente comme un flambeau; et elle tomba sur le tiers des fleuves et sur les sources des eaux.
verses.am: ሦስተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ እንደ ችቦም የሚቃጠል ታላቅ ኮከብ ከሰማይ ወደቀ፥ በወንዞችና በውኃም ምንጮች ሲሶ ላይ ወደቀ። የኮከቡም ስም እሬቶ ይባላል።

verses.en: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
verses.fr: Le nom de cette étoile est Absinthe; et le tiers des eaux fut changé en absinthe, et beaucoup d''hommes moururent par les eaux, parce qu''elles étaient devenues amères.
verses.am: የውኃውም ሲሶ መራራ ሆነ መራራም ስለተደረገ በውኃው ጠንቅ ብዙ ሰዎች ሞቱ።

verses.en: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
verses.fr: Le quatrième ange sonna de la trompette. Et le tiers du soleil fut frappé, et le tiers de la lune, et le tiers des étoiles, afin que le tiers en fût obscurci, et que le jour perdît un tiers de sa clarté, et la nuit de même.
verses.am: አራተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ የፀሐይ ሲሶና የጨረቃ ሲሶ የከዋክብትም ሲሶ ተመታ፥ የእነዚህ ሲሶ ይጨልም ዘንድ፥ የቀንም ሲሶው እንዳያበራ፥ እንዲሁም የሌሊት።

verses.en: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
verses.fr: Je regardai, et j''entendis un aigle qui volait au milieu du ciel, disant d''une voix forte: Malheur, malheur, malheur aux habitants de la terre, à cause des autres sons de la trompette des trois anges qui vont sonner!
verses.am: አየሁም፥ አንድም ንስር በሰማይ መካከል እየበረረ በታላቅ ድምፅ። ሊነፉ ያላቸው የሦስቱ መላእክት መለከት ስለሚቀረው ድምፅ በምድር ላይ ለሚኖሩት ወዮላቸው፥ ወዮላቸው፥ ወዮላቸው ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
verses.fr: Le cinquième ange sonna de la trompette. Et je vis une étoile qui était tombée du ciel sur la terre. La clef du puits de l''abîme lui fut donnée,
verses.am: አምስተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ ከሰማይም ወደ ምድር ወድቆ የነበረ ኮከብ አየሁ፥ የጥልቁም ጕድጓድ መክፈቻ ተሰጠው።

verses.en: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
verses.fr: et elle ouvrit le puits de l''abîme. Et il monta du puits une fumée, comme la fumée d''une grande fournaise; et le soleil et l''air furent obscurcis par la fumée du puits.
verses.am: የጥልቁንም ጕድጓድ ከፈተው፤ ጢስም ከታላቅ እቶን እንደሚወጣ ጢስ ሆኖ ከጕድጓዱ ወጣ ፀሐይና አየርም በጕድጓዱ ጢስ ጨለሙ።

verses.en: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
verses.fr: De la fumée sortirent des sauterelles, qui se répandirent sur la terre; et il leur fut donné un pouvoir comme le pouvoir qu''ont les scorpions de la terre.
verses.am: ከጢሱም አንበጣዎች ወደ ምድር ወጡ፥ የምድርም ጊንጦች ሥልጣን እንዳላቸው ሥልጣን ተሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.
verses.fr: Il leur fut dit de ne point faire de mal à l''herbe de la terre, ni à aucune verdure, ni à aucun arbre, mais seulement aux hommes qui n''avaient pas le sceau de Dieu sur le front.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ማኅተም በግምባራቸው ከሌለባቸው ሰዎች በቀር በምድር ያለውን ሣር ቢሆንም ወይም ማናቸውንም የለመለመ ነገር ወይም ማናቸውንም ዛፍ እንዳይጐዱ ተባለላቸው።

verses.en: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
verses.fr: Il leur fut donné, non de les tuer, mais de les tourmenter pendant cinq mois; et le tourment qu''elles causaient était comme le tourment que cause le scorpion, quand il pique un homme.
verses.am: አምስትም ወር ሊሣቅዩአቸው ተሰጣቸው እንጂ ሊገድሉአቸው አይደለም፤ እነርሱም የሚሣቅዩት ሥቃይ ጊንጥ ሰውን ነድፎ እንደሚሣቅይ ነው።

verses.en: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
verses.fr: En ces jours-là, les hommes chercheront la mort, et ils ne la trouveront pas; ils désireront mourir, et la mort fuira loin d''eux.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት ሰዎች ሞትን ይፈልጋሉ አያገኙትምም፥ ሊሞቱም ይመኛሉ ሞትም ከእነርሱ ይሸሻል።

verses.en: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
verses.fr: Ces sauterelles ressemblaient à des chevaux préparés pour le combat; il y avait sur leurs têtes comme des couronnes semblables à de l''or, et leurs visages étaient comme des visages d''hommes.
verses.am: የአንበጣዎቹም መልክ ለጦርነት እንደ ተዘጋጁ ፈረሶች ነው፥ በራሳቸውም ላይ ወርቅ እንደሚመስሉ አክሊሎች ነበሩአቸው፥ ፊታቸውም እንደ ሰው ፊት ነበረ፤

verses.en: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
verses.fr: Elles avaient des cheveux comme des cheveux de femmes, et leurs dents étaient comme des dents de lions.
verses.am: የሴቶችን ጠጕር የሚመስል ጠጕር ነበራቸው፥ ጥርሳቸውም እንደ አንበሳ ጥርስ ነበረ፥

verses.en: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
verses.fr: Elles avaient des cuirasses comme des cuirasses de fer, et le bruit de leurs ailes était comme un bruit de chars à plusieurs chevaux qui courent au combat.
verses.am: የብረት ጥሩር የሚመስልም ጥሩር ነበራቸው፥ የክንፋቸውም ድምፅ ወደ ጦርነት እንደሚጋልቡ እንደ ብዙ ፈረሶች ሰረገላዎች ድምፅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
verses.fr: Elles avaient des queues semblables à des scorpions et des aiguillons, et c''est dans leurs queues qu''était le pouvoir de faire du mal aux hommes pendant cinq mois.
verses.am: እንደ ጊንጥም ጅራት ያለ ጅራት አላቸው በጅራታቸውም መውጊያ አለ፥ ሰዎችንም አምስት ወር እንዲጐዱ ሥልጣን አላቸው።

verses.en: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.
verses.fr: Elles avaient sur elles comme roi l''ange de l''abîme, nommé en hébreu Abaddon, et en grec Apollyon.
verses.am: በእነርሱም ላይ ንጉሥ አላቸው እርሱም የጥልቅ መልአክ ነው፥ ስሙም በዕብራይስጥ አብዶን በግሪክም አጶልዮን ይባላል።

verses.en: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
verses.fr: Le premier malheur est passé. Voici il vient encore deux malheurs après cela.
verses.am: ፊተኛው ወዮ አልፎአል፤ እነሆ፥ ከዚህ በኋላ ገና ሁለት ወዮ ይመጣል።

verses.en: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
verses.fr: Le sixième ange sonna de la trompette. Et j''entendis une voix venant des quatre cornes de l''autel d''or qui est devant Dieu,
verses.am: ስድስተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ካለ በወርቅ ከተሠራ መሠዊያ ቀንዶች አንድ ድምፅ ሰማሁ፥

verses.en: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
verses.fr: et disant au sixième ange qui avait la trompette: Délie les quatre anges qui sont liés sur le grand fleuve d''Euphrate.
verses.am: መለከትም ያለውን ስድስተኛውን መልአክ። በታላቁ ወንዝ በኤፍራጥስ የታሰሩትን አራቱን መላእክት ፍታቸው አለው።

verses.en: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
verses.fr: Et les quatre anges qui étaient prêts pour l''heure, le jour, le mois et l''année, furent déliés afin qu''ils tuassent le tiers des hommes.
verses.am: የሰዎችንም ሲሶ እንዲገድሉ ለሰዓቱና ለቀኑ ለወሩም ለዓመቱም ተዘጋጅተው የነበሩ አራቱ መላእክት ተፈቱ።

verses.en: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
verses.fr: Le nombre des cavaliers de l''armée était de deux myriades de myriades: j''en entendis le nombre.
verses.am: የፈረሰኞችም ጭፍራ ቁጥር እልፍ ጊዜ እልፍ፥ እልፍ ጊዜ እልፍ ነበረ፤ ቁጥራቸውን ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
verses.fr: Et ainsi je vis les chevaux dans la vision, et ceux qui les montaient, ayant des cuirasses couleur de feu, d''hyacinthe, et de soufre. Les têtes des chevaux étaient comme des têtes de lions; et de leurs bouches il sortait du feu, de la fumée, et du soufre.
verses.am: ፈረሶቹንና በእነርሱም ላይ የተቀመጡትን እንዲሁ በራእይ አየሁ፤ እሳትና ያክንት ዲንም የሚመስል ጥሩር ነበራቸው፤ የፈረሶቹም ራስ እንደ አንበሳ ራስ ነበረ፥ ከአፋቸውም እሳትና ጢስ ዲንም ወጣ።

verses.en: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
verses.fr: Le tiers des hommes fut tué par ces trois fléaux, par le feu, par la fumée, et par le soufre, qui sortaient de leurs bouches.
verses.am: ከአፋቸውም በወጡት በእሳቱና በጢሱ በዲኑም በእነዚህ ሦስት መቅሰፍቶች የሰዎቹ ሲሶ ተገደለ።

verses.en: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
verses.fr: Car le pouvoir des chevaux était dans leurs bouches et dans leurs queues; leurs queues étaient semblables à des serpents ayant des têtes, et c''est avec elles qu''ils faisaient du mal.
verses.am: የፈረሶቹ ሥልጣን በአፋቸውና በጅራታቸው ነውና፤ ጅራታቸው እባብን ይመስላልና፥ ራስም አላቸው በእርሱም ይጐዳሉ።

verses.en: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
verses.fr: Les autres hommes qui ne furent pas tués par ces fléaux ne se repentirent pas des oeuvres de leurs mains, de manière à ne point adorer les démons, et les idoles d''or, d''argent, d''airain, de pierre et de bois, qui ne peuvent ni voir, ni entendre, ni marcher;
verses.am: በእነዚህም መቅሠፍቶች ያልተገደሉት የቀሩቱ ሰዎች ለአጋንንትና ያዩ ወይም ይሰሙ ወይም ይሄዱ ዘንድ ለማይችሉ ከወርቅና ከብር ከናስም ከድንጋይም ከእንጨትም ለተሠሩ ለጣዖቶች እንዳይሰግዱ ስለ እጃቸው ሥራ ንስሐ አልገቡም፤

verses.en: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
verses.fr: et ils ne se repentirent pas de leurs meurtres, ni de leurs enchantements, ni de leur impudicité ni de leurs vols.
verses.am: ስለ መግደላቸውም ቢሆን ወይም ስለ አስማታቸው ወይም ስለ ዝሙታቸው ወይም ስለ ስርቆታቸው ንስሐ አልገቡም።

verses.en: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
verses.fr: Je vis un autre ange puissant, qui descendait du ciel, enveloppé d''une nuée; au-dessus de sa tête était l''arc-en-ciel, et son visage était comme le soleil, et ses pieds comme des colonnes de feu.
verses.am: ሌላም ብርቱ መልአክ ደመና ተጐናጽፎ ከሰማይ ሲወርድ አየሁ፤ በራሱም ላይ ቀስተ ደመና ነበረ፥ ፊቱም እንደ ፀሐይ እግሮቹም እንደ እሳት ዓምዶች ነበሩ፥

verses.en: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
verses.fr: Il tenait dans sa main un petit livre ouvert. Il posa son pied droit sur la mer, et son pied gauche sur la terre;
verses.am: የተከፈተችንም ታናሽ መጽሐፍ በእጁ ያዘ። ቀኝ እግሩንም በባሕር ላይ ግራውንም በምድር ላይ አኖረ፥ እንደሚያገሣም አንበሳ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
verses.fr: et il cria d''une voix forte, comme rugit un lion. Quand il cria, les sept tonnerres firent entendre leurs voix.
verses.am: በጮኸም ጊዜ ሰባቱ ነጐድጓድ በየድምፃቸው ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
verses.fr: Et quand les sept tonnerres eurent fait entendre leurs voix, j''allais écrire; et j''entendis du ciel une voix qui disait: Scelle ce qu''ont dit les sept tonnerres, et ne l''écris pas.
verses.am: ሰባቱ ነጐድጓድ በተናገሩ ጊዜ ልጽፍ አሰብሁ፤ ከሰማይም። ሰባቱ ነጐድጓድ የተናገሩትን ነገር በማኅተም ዝጋው አትጻፈውም የሚል ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
verses.fr: Et l''ange, que je voyais debout sur la mer et sur la terre, leva sa main droite vers le ciel,
verses.am: በባሕርና በምድርም ላይ ሲቆም ያየሁት መልአክ ቀኝ እጁን ወደ ሰማይ አሻቅቦ ዘረጋ፥

verses.en: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:
verses.fr: et jura par celui qui vit aux siècles des siècles, qui a créé le ciel et les choses qui y sont, la terre et les choses qui y sont, et la mer et les choses qui y sont, qu''il n''y aurait plus de temps,
verses.am: ሰማይንና በእርሱም ያሉትን፥ ምድርንና በእርስዋም ያሉትን፥ ባሕርንና በእርሱም ያሉትን በፈጠረው፥ ከዘላለምም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ሕያው ሆኖ በሚኖረው ምሎ።

verses.en: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.
verses.fr: mais qu''aux jours de la voix du septième ange, quand il sonnerait de la trompette, le mystère de Dieu s''accomplirait, comme il l''a annoncé à ses serviteurs, les prophètes.
verses.am: ወደ ፊት አይዘገይም፥ ዳሩ ግን ሰባተኛው መልአክ ሊነፋ ባለው ጊዜ ድምፁም በሚሰማበት ዘመን፥ ለባሪያዎቹ ለነቢያት የምስራች እንደ ሰበከላቸው የእግዚአብሔር ምሥጢር ይፈጸማል አለ።

verses.en: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.
verses.fr: Et la voix, que j''avais entendue du ciel, me parla de nouveau, et dit: Va, prends le petit livre ouvert dans la main de l''ange qui se tient debout sur la mer et sur la terre.
verses.am: ከሰማይም የሰማሁት ድምፅ እንደ ገና ሲናገረኝና። ሂድና በባሕርና በምድር ላይ ከሚቆመው መልአክ በእጁ ያለችውን የተከፈተችውን መጽሐፍ ውሰድ ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.
verses.fr: Et j''allai vers l''ange, en lui disant de me donner le petit livre. Et il me dit: Prends-le, et avale-le; il sera amer à tes entrailles, mais dans ta bouche il sera doux comme du miel.
verses.am: ወደ መልአኩም ሄጄ። ታናሺቱን መጽሐፍ ስጠኝ አልሁት። እርሱም። ውሰድና ብላት፥ ሆድህንም መራራ ታደርገዋለች በአፍህ ግን እንደ ማር ትጣፍጣለች አለኝ።

verses.en: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
verses.fr: Je pris le petit livre de la main de l''ange, et je l''avalai; il fut dans ma bouche doux comme du miel, mais quand je l''eus avalé, mes entrailles furent remplies d''amertume.
verses.am: ከመልአኩም እጅ ታናሺቱን መጽሐፍ ወስጄ በላኋት በአፌም እንደ ማር ጣፋጭ ሆነች፤ ከበላኋት በኋላም ሆዴ መራራ ሆነ።

verses.en: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
verses.fr: Puis on me dit: Il faut que tu prophétises de nouveau sur beaucoup de peuples, de nations, de langues, et de rois.
verses.am: በብዙ ወገኖችና በአሕዛብም በቋንቋዎችም በነገሥታትም ላይ እንደ ገና ትንቢት ትናገር ዘንድ ይገባሃል ተባለልኝ።

verses.en: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.
verses.fr: On me donna un roseau semblable à une verge, en disant: Lève-toi, et mesure le temple de Dieu, l''autel, et ceux qui y adorent.
verses.am: በትር የሚመስል መለኪያ ለእኔ ተሰጠኝ፥ እንዲህም ተባለልኝ። ተነሥተህ የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስና መሠዊያውን በዚያም የሚሰግዱትን ለካ።

verses.en: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
verses.fr: Mais le parvis extérieur du temple, laisse-le en dehors, et ne le mesure pas; car il a été donné aux nations, et elles fouleront aux pieds la ville sainte pendant quarante-deux mois.
verses.am: በመቅደሱም ውጭ ያለው እድሞ ለአሕዛብ ተሰጥቶአልና ተወው አትለካውም፤ እነርሱም አርባ ሁለት ወር የተቀደሰችውን ከተማ ይረግጡአታል።

verses.en: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
verses.fr: Je donnerai à mes deux témoins le pouvoir de prophétiser, revêtus de sacs, pendant mille deux cent soixante jours.
verses.am: ለሁለቱም ምስክሮቼ ማቅ ለብሰው ሺህ ከሁለት መቶ ስድሳ ቀን ትንቢት ሊናገሩ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.
verses.fr: Ce sont les deux oliviers et les deux chandeliers qui se tiennent devant le Seigneur de la terre.
verses.am: እነዚህ በምድር ጌታ ፊት የሚቆሙ ሁለቱ ወይራዎችና ሁለቱ መቅረዞች ናቸው።

verses.en: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un veut leur faire du mal, du feu sort de leur bouche et dévore leurs ennemis; et si quelqu''un veut leur faire du mal, il faut qu''il soit tué de cette manière.
verses.am: ማንምም ሊጐዳቸው ቢወድ እሳት ከአፋቸው ይወጣል ጠላቶቻቸውንም ይበላል፤ ማንም ሊጐዳቸው ቢወድም እንዲሁ ሊገደል ይገባዋል።

verses.en: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
verses.fr: Ils ont le pouvoir de fermer le ciel, afin qu''il ne tombe point de pluie pendant les jours de leur prophétie; et ils ont le pouvoir de changer les eaux en sang, et de frapper la terre de toute espèce de plaie, chaque fois qu''ils le voudront.
verses.am: እነዚህ ትንቢት በሚናገሩበት ወራት ዝናብ እንዳይዘንብ ሰማይን ሊዘጉ ሥልጣን አላቸው፥ ውኃዎችንም ወደ ደም ሊለውጡ በሚፈልጉበትም ጊዜ ሁሉ በመቅሠፍት ሁሉ ምድርን ሊመቱ ሥልጣን አላቸው።

verses.en: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
verses.fr: Quand ils auront achevé leur témoignage, la bête qui monte de l''abîme leur fera la guerre, les vaincra, et les tuera.
verses.am: ምስክራቸውን ከፈጸሙ በኋላ ከጥልቁ የሚወጣው አውሬ ይዋጋቸዋል ያሸንፋቸውማል ይገድላቸውማል።

verses.en: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
verses.fr: Et leurs cadavres seront sur la place de la grande ville, qui est appelée, dans un sens spirituel, Sodome et Egypte, là même où leur Seigneur a été crucifié.
verses.am: በድናቸውም በታላቂቱ ከተማ አደባባይ ይተኛል እርስዋም በመንፈሳዊ ምሳሌ ሰዶምና ግብጽ የተባለች ደግሞ ጌታቸው የተሰቀለባት ናት።

verses.en: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
verses.fr: Des hommes d''entre les peuples, les tribus, les langues, et les nations, verront leurs cadavres pendant trois jours et demi, et ils ne permettront pas que leurs cadavres soient mis dans un sépulcre.
verses.am: ከወገኖችና ከነገዶችም ከቋንቋዎችም ከአሕዛብም የሆኑ ሰዎች ሦስት ቀን ተኵል በድናቸውን ይመለከታሉ፥ በድናቸውም ወደ መቃብር ሊገባ አይፈቅዱም።

verses.en: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.
verses.fr: Et à cause d''eux les habitants de la terre se réjouiront et seront dans l''allégresse, et ils s''enverront des présents les uns aux autres, parce que ces deux prophètes ont tourmenté les habitants de la terre.
verses.am: እነዚህም ሁለት ነቢያት በምድር የሚኖሩትን ስለ ሣቀዩ በምድር የሚኖሩት በእነርሱ ላይ ደስ ይላቸዋል በደስታም ይኖራሉ እርስ በርሳቸውም ስጦታ ይሰጣጣሉ።

verses.en: And after three days and an half the spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.
verses.fr: Après les trois jours et demi, un esprit de vie, venant de Dieu, entra en eux, et ils se tinrent sur leurs pieds; et une grande crainte s''empara de ceux qui les voyaient.
verses.am: ከሦስቱ ቀን ተኵልም በኋላ ከእግዚአብሔር የወጣ የሕይወት መንፈስ ገባባቸው በእግሮቻቸውም ቆሙ፥ ታላቅም ፍርሃት በሚመለከቱት ላይ ወደቀባቸው።

verses.en: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
verses.fr: Et ils entendirent du ciel une voix qui leur disait: Montez ici! Et ils montèrent au ciel dans la nuée; et leurs ennemis les virent.
verses.am: በሰማይም። ወደዚህ ውጡ የሚላቸውን ታላቅ ድምፅ ሰሙ፤ ጠላቶቻቸውም እየተመለከቱአቸው ወደ ሰማይ በደመና ወጡ።

verses.en: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.fr: A cette heure-là, il y eut un grand tremblement de terre, et la dixième partie de la ville, tomba; sept mille hommes furent tués dans ce tremblement de terre, et les autres furent effrayés et donnèrent gloire au Dieu du ciel.
verses.am: በዚያም ሰዓት ታላቅ የምድር መናወጥ ሆነ፥ ከከተማይቱም አሥረኛው እጅ ወደቀ፥ በመናወጥም ሰባት ሺህ ሰዎች ተገደሉ፥ የቀሩትንም ፍርሃት ያዛቸው፥ ለሰማዩም አምላክ ክብር ሰጡ።

verses.en: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.
verses.fr: Le second malheur est passé. Voici, le troisième malheur vient bientôt.
verses.am: ሁለተኛው ወዮ አልፎአል፤ እነሆ፥ ሦስተኛው ወዮ በቶሎ ይመጣል።

verses.en: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
