verses.fr: La muraille était construite en jaspe, et la ville était d''or pur, semblable à du verre pur.
verses.am: ቅጥርዋም ከኢያሰጲድ የተሠራ ነበረ፥ ከተማይቱም ጥሩ ብርጭቆ የሚመስል ጥሩ ወርቅ ነበረች።

verses.en: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
verses.fr: Les fondements de la muraille de la ville étaient ornés de pierres précieuses de toute espèce: le premier fondement était de jaspe, le second de saphir, le troisième de calcédoine, le quatrième d''émeraude,
verses.am: የከተማይቱም ቅጥር መሠረት በከበረ ድንጋይ ሁሉ ተጌጦ ነበር፤ ፊተኛው መሠረት ኢያሰጲድ፥ ሁለተኛው ሰንፔር፥ ሦስተኛው ኬልቄዶን፥ አራተኛው መረግድ፥

verses.en: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolyte; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
verses.fr: le cinquième de sardonyx, le sixième de sardoine, le septième de chrysolithe, le huitième de béryl, le neuvième de topaze, le dixième de chrysoprase, le onzième d''hyacinthe, le douzième d''améthyste.
verses.am: አምስተኛው ሰርዶንክስ፥ ስድስተኛው ሰርድዮን፥ ሰባተኛው ክርስቲሎቤ፥ ስምንተኛው ቢረሌ፥ ዘጠነኛው ወራውሬ፥ አሥረኛው ክርስጵራስስ፥ አሥራ አንደኛው ያክንት፥ አሥራ ሁለተኛው አሜቴስጢኖስ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls: every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
verses.fr: Les douze portes étaient douze perles; chaque porte était d''une seule perle. La place de la ville était d''or pur, comme du verre transparent.
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለቱም ደጆች አሥራ ሁለት ዕንቆች ነበሩ፤ እየአንዳንዱ ደጅ ከአንድ ዕንቍ የተሠራ ነበረ። የከተማይቱም አደባባይ ጥሩ ብርጭቆ የሚመስል ጥሩ ወርቅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
verses.fr: Je ne vis point de temple dans la ville; car le Seigneur Dieu tout-puissant est son temple, ainsi que l''agneau.
verses.am: ሁሉንም የሚገዛ ጌታ አምላክና በጉ መቅደስዋ ናቸውና መቅደስ በእርስዋ ዘንድ አላየሁም።

verses.en: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
verses.fr: La ville n''a besoin ni du soleil ni de la lune pour l''éclairer; car la gloire de Dieu l''éclaire, et l''agneau est son flambeau.
verses.am: ለከተማይቱም የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ስለሚያበራላት መብራትዋም በጉ ስለ ሆነ፥ ፀሐይ ወይም ጨረቃ እንዲያበሩላት አያስፈልጓትም ነበር።

verses.en: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
verses.fr: Les nations marcheront à sa lumière, et les rois de la terre y apporteront leur gloire.
verses.am: አሕዛብም በብርሃንዋ ይመላለሳሉ፥ የምድርም ነገሥታት ክብራቸውን ወደ እርስዋ ያመጣሉ፤

verses.en: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
verses.fr: Ses portes ne se fermeront point le jour, car là il n''y aura point de nuit.
verses.am: በዚያም ሌሊት ስለሌለ ደጆችዋ በቀን ከቶ አይዘጉም፥

verses.en: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
verses.fr: On y apportera la gloire et l''honneur des nations.
verses.am: የአሕዛብንም ግርማና ክብር ወደ እርስዋ ያመጣሉ።

verses.en: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb's book of life.
verses.fr: Il n''entrera chez elle rien de souillé, ni personne qui se livre à l''abomination et au mensonge; il n''entrera que ceux qui sont écrits dans le livre de vie de l''agneau.
verses.am: ለበጉም በሆነው በሕይወት መጽሐፍ ከተጻፉት በቀር፥ ጸያፍ ነገር ሁሉ ርኵሰትና ውሸትም የሚያደርግ ወደ እርስዋ ከቶ አይገባም።

verses.en: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
verses.fr: Et il me montra un fleuve d''eau de la vie, limpide comme du cristal, qui sortait du trône de Dieu et de l''agneau.
verses.am: በአደባባይዋም መካከል ከእግዚአብሔርና ከበጉ ዙፋን የሚወጣውን እንደ ብርሌ የሚያንጸባርቀውን የሕይወትን ውኃ ወንዝ አሳየኝ።

verses.en: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
verses.fr: Au milieu de la place de la ville et sur les deux bords du fleuve, il y avait un arbre de vie, produisant douze fois des fruits, rendant son fruit chaque mois, et dont les feuilles servaient à la guérison des nations.
verses.am: በወንዙም ወዲያና ወዲህ በየወሩ እያፈራ አሥራ ሁለት ፍሬ የሚሰጥ የሕይወት ዛፍ ነበረ፥ የዛፉም ቅጠሎች ለሕዝብ መፈወሻ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
verses.fr: Il n''y aura plus d''anathème. Le trône de Dieu et de l''agneau sera dans la ville; ses serviteurs le serviront
verses.am: ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ መርገም ከቶ አይሆንም። የእግዚአብሔርና የበጉም ዙፋን በእርስዋ ውስጥ ይሆናል፥ ባሪያዎቹም ያመልኩታል፥ ፊቱንም ያያሉ፥

verses.en: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
verses.fr: et verront sa face, et son nom sera sur leurs fronts.
verses.am: ስሙም በግምባሮቻቸው ይሆናል።

verses.en: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Il n''y aura plus de nuit; et ils n''auront besoin ni de lampe ni de lumière, parce que le Seigneur Dieu les éclairera. Et ils régneront aux siècles des siècles.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ሌሊት አይሆንም፥ ጌታ አምላክም በእነርሱ ላይ ያበራላቸዋልና የመብራት ብርሃንና የፀሐይ ብርሃን አያስፈልጋቸውም፤ ለዘላለምም እስከ ዘላለም ይነግሣሉ።

verses.en: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
verses.fr: Et il me dit: Ces paroles sont certaines et véritables; et le Seigneur, le Dieu des esprits des prophètes, a envoyé son ange pour montrer à ses serviteurs les choses qui doivent arriver bientôt.
verses.am: እርሱም። እነዚህ ቃሎች የታመኑና እውነተኛዎች ናቸው፥ የነቢያትም መናፍስት ጌታ አምላክ በቶሎ ሊሆን የሚገባውን ነገር ለባሪያዎቹ እንዲያሳይ መልአኩን ሰደደ።

verses.en: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
verses.fr: Et voici, je viens bientôt. -Heureux celui qui garde les paroles de la prophétie de ce livre!
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በቶሎ እመጣለሁ። የዚህን መጽሐፍ ትንቢት ቃል የሚጠብቅ ብፁዕ ነው አለኝ።

verses.en: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
verses.fr: C''est moi Jean, qui ai entendu et vu ces choses. Et quand j''eus entendu et vu, je tombai aux pieds de l''ange qui me les montrait, pour l''adorer.
verses.am: ይህንም ያየሁትና የሰማሁት እኔ ዮሐንስ ነኝ። በሰማሁትና ባየሁትም ጊዜ ይህን ባሳየኝ በመልአኩ እግር ፊት እሰግድ ዘንድ ተደፋሁ።

verses.en: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
verses.fr: Mais il me dit: Garde-toi de le faire! Je suis ton compagnon de service, et celui de tes frères les prophètes, et de ceux qui gardent les paroles de ce livre. Adore Dieu.
verses.am: እርሱም። እንዳታደርገው ተጠንቀቅ፤ ከአንተ ጋር ከወንድሞችህም ከነቢያት ጋር የዚህንም መጽሐፍ ቃል ከሚጠብቁ ጋር አብሬ ባሪያ ነኝ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገድ አለኝ።

verses.en: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
verses.fr: Et il me dit: Ne scelle point les paroles de la prophétie de ce livre. Car le temps est proche.
verses.am: ለእኔም። ዘመኑ ቀርቦአልና የዚህን መጽሐፍ ትንቢት ቃል በማኅተም አትዝጋው።

verses.en: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
verses.fr: Que celui qui est injuste soit encore injuste, que celui qui est souillé se souille encore; et que le juste pratique encore la justice, et que celui qui est saint se sanctifie encore.
verses.am: ዓመፀኛው ወደ ፊት ያምፅ፥ ርኵሱም ወደ ፊት ይርከስ፥ ጻድቁም ወደ ፊት ጽድቅ ያድርግ፥ ቅዱሱም ወደፊት ይቀደስ አለ።

verses.en: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
verses.fr: Voici, je viens bientôt, et ma rétribution est avec moi, pour rendre à chacun selon ce qu''est son oeuvre.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በቶሎ እመጣለሁ፥ ለእያንዳንዱም እንደ ሥራው መጠን እከፍል ዘንድ ዋጋዬ ከእኔ ጋር አለ።

verses.en: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
verses.fr: Je suis l''alpha et l''oméga, le premier et le dernier, le commencement et la fin.
verses.am: አልፋና ዖሜጋ፥ ፊተኛውና ኋለኛው፥ መጀመሪያውና መጨረሻው እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
verses.fr: Heureux ceux qui lavent leurs robes, afin d''avoir droit à l''arbre de vie, et d''entrer par les portes dans la ville!
verses.am: ወደ ሕይወት ዛፍ ለመድረስ ሥልጣን እንዲኖራቸው በደጆችዋም ወደ ከተማይቱም እንዲገቡ ልብሳቸውን የሚያጥቡ ብፁዓን ናቸው።

verses.en: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.
verses.fr: Dehors les chiens, les enchanteurs, les impudiques, les meurtriers, les idolâtres, et quiconque aime et pratique le mensonge!
verses.am: ውሻዎችና አስማተኞች ሴሰኛዎችም ነፍሰ ገዳዮችም ጣዖትንም የሚያመልኩት ውሸትንም የሚወዱና የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ በውጭ አሉ።

verses.en: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
verses.fr: Moi, Jésus, j''ai envoyé mon ange pour vous attester ces choses dans les Eglises. Je suis le rejeton et la postérité de David, l''étoile brillante du matin.
verses.am: እኔ ኢየሱስ በአብያተ ክርስቲያናት ዘንድ ይህን እንዲመሰክርላችሁ መልአኬን ላክሁ። እኔ የዳዊት ሥርና ዘር ነኝ፥ የሚያበራም የንጋት ኮከብ ነኝ።

verses.en: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
verses.fr: Et l''Esprit et l''épouse disent: Viens. Et que celui qui entend dise: Viens. Et que celui qui a soif vienne; que celui qui veut, prenne de l''eau de la vie, gratuitement.
verses.am: መንፈሱና ሙሽራይቱም። ና ይላሉ። የሚሰማም። ና ይበል። የተጠማም ይምጣ፥ የወደደም የሕይወትን ውኃ እንዲያው ይውሰድ።

verses.en: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
verses.fr: Je le déclare à quiconque entend les paroles de la prophétie de ce livre: Si quelqu''un y ajoute quelque chose, Dieu le frappera des fléaux décrits dans ce livre;
verses.am: በዚህ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን የትንቢት ቃል ለሚሰማ ሁሉ እኔ እመሰክራለሁ፤ ማንም በዚህ ላይ አንዳች ቢጨምር እግዚአብሔር በዚህ መጽሐፍ የተጻፉትን መቅሠፍቶች ይጨምርበታል፤

verses.en: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
verses.fr: et si quelqu''un retranche quelque chose des paroles du livre de cette prophétie, Dieu retranchera sa part de l''arbre de la vie et de la ville sainte, décrits dans ce livre.
verses.am: ማንምም በዚህ በትንቢት መጽሐፍ ከተጻፉት ቃሎች አንዳች ቢያጎድል፥ በዚህ መጽሐፍ ከተጻፉት ከሕይወት ዛፍና ከቅድስቲቱ ከተማ እግዚአብሔር ዕድሉን ያጎድልበታል።

verses.en: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
verses.fr: Celui qui atteste ces choses dit: Oui, je viens bientôt. Amen! Viens, Seigneur Jésus!
verses.am: ይህን የሚመሰክር። አዎን፥ በቶሎ እመጣለሁ ይላል። አሜን፥ ጌታ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ና።

verses.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.fr: Que la grâce du Seigneur Jésus soit avec tous!
verses.am: የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።
